title: Vision Transformer: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words

beats.text: For years, computer vision was held hostage by convolutional filters, ignoring the global context of every pixel.
beats.visual_focus: Grid of image pixels shifting into high-dimensional space

beats.text: The bottleneck isn't the data, it's our rigid reliance on spatial locality; we treat 2D images like 1D text tokens.

beats.text: We force the image into the Transformer by chopping it into 16 by 16 patches, then flattening them into vectors.

beats.text: The secret is the learnable [CLS] token: a global sentinel that aggregates semantic information across every single patch coordinate.
